timing_help.twentieth: Current month 11–20 average prices compared with the previous month’s 11–20 averages. These are period averages, not point prices observed exactly on the 20th.
timing_help.final: Average of current 1–10 and 11–20 prices compared with the same two periods in the previous month.
timing_help.early: Current 1–10 prices compared with previous month 1–10 prices. No 11–20 prices enter this specification.
timing_help.early_carry: Early-month changes plus previous 21–end to current 1–10 carry-in changes.
